levels.name: Normal
levels.tagline: keeps its pairs, protects the big boxes

help.goal: Fill all thirteen boxes on your scorecard with dice combinations. Highest total at the end wins.
steps: Tap Roll to throw the five dice.
Tap any dice you want to keep; they are held for the next roll.
Roll up to three times in a turn, holding more each time.
Tap a box below to see what your dice would score there.
Tap the same box again to write that score down.
notes: Each box is used once. A box that does not fit your dice scores zero.
Score 63 or more across Ones to Sixes for a 35 point bonus.
You must roll at least once before a box can be scored.
Play with fewer people and bots take the empty seats: Easy rolls and writes it down, Normal keeps its pairs, Sharp chases the bonus.
